title: 基于NLP的古代印度医学文献知识提取与主题分类
summary: 该研究利用NLP技术（NER、BERTopic、知识图谱）对古代印度医学文献（如Sushruta Samhita）进行概念提取、主题分类和关系可视化，以提升可访问性和系统化整理，促进数字人文和医学信息学研究。
summary_en: This research applies NLP techniques (NER, BERTopic, knowledge graphs) to extract, categorize, and visualize concepts from ancient Indian medical texts, improving accessibility and systematic organization, bridging traditional knowledge and data-driven inquiry.
